decisions.reason: It builds directly on the established BASIC 518 trommel screen, and its continued own-page presence and positive customer mention signal that the firm can interpret and exploit its related screening knowledge.

Flail shredders are less central to the firm's existing shredder knowledge than single-shaft pre-shredders, and the weaker 2019 website presence creates some uncertainty, but its ongoing trade-fair promotion suggests the firm still sees value and can improve it.
The mobile high-speed grinder moved from a mention to its own page, indicating the firm has assimilated early results and sees enough related grinder expertise to continue developing it.

Stationary single-shaft pre-shredders are close to the firm's core pre-shredder knowledge, and the new CERON generation with a quantified customer application shows strong absorptive capacity and successful learning.
